description:
Damage areas for Volcano, Democratic Republic of the Congo, 23 May 2021 (VO20210523COD): 3,289 features merged from 10 source layers. Polygon layers with a damage class column: damaged areas, zones, or density cells. The `source_layer` and `source_file` columns name the layer and file each row came from.

From these HDX datasets:

- [Coulée de lave et structures affectées suite à l'éruption volcanique du Nyiragongo, Province du Nord-Kivu, RD Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/coulee-de-lave-et-structures-affectees-suite-a-l-eruption-volcanique-du-nyiragongo-provinc)
- [Lava flow and affected structures caused by  the volcanic eruption of the 22 May 2021 in Kanyanza village, DR Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/lava-flow-and-affected-structures-caused-by-the-volcanic-eruption-of-the-22-may-2021-in-ka)
- [Lava flow and affected structures caused by Nyiragongo volcanic eruption, Nord-Kivu Province, DR Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/lava-flow-and-affected-structures-caused-by-nyiragongo-volcanic-eruption-nord-kivu-provinc)
- [Lava flow and affected structures caused by the volcanic eruption of the 22 May 2021 in north of Goma airport, DR Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/lava-flow-and-affected-structures-caused-by-the-volcanic-eruption-of-the-22-may-2021-in-no)
- [Lava flow and geological information in NordKivu Province, DR Congo and Western Province, Rwanda as of 01 June 2021](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/lava-flow-and-geological-information-in-nordkivu-province-dr-congo-and-western-province-rw)
- [Lava flow and geological information related to the volcanic eruption in DR Congo and Rwanda as of 27 May 2021](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/lava-flow-and-geological-information-related-to-the-volcanic-eruption-in-dr-congo-and-rwan)
- [Lava flow extent and affected structures caused by the 22 May 2021 Nyiragongo volcanic eruption in Goma, DR Congo](https://data.humdata.org/dataset/lava-flow-extent-and-affected-structures-caused-by-the-22-may-2021-nyiragongo-volcanic-eru)

Read [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) for the columns and query recipes.

table:columns.name: SiteID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = UN Building; 1 = Mosque; 2 = Hospital; 3 = Refugee / IDP Camp Building; 4 = Market; 5 = School / University; 6 = Square; 7 = Government Building; 9 = Border Crossing Point; 12 = Cemetary; 13 = Ruins; 16 = Staduim; 19 = Sewage Treatment Facility; 21 = Greenhouse; 22 = Bridge; 23 = Road; 24 = Tower; 25 = Prison; 26 = Building (General / Default); 27 = Field; 28 = Industrial Facility; 30 = Refugee / IDP Camp Site; 35 = Transport Vehicle; 40 = Military Base; 41 = Checkpoint; 42 = Military Facility; 45 = Suspected Mass Grave Site; 46 = Airport Facility; 47 = Church. The decoded text is in `SiteID_label`.

table:columns.name: SensorDate
table:columns.description: Acquisition date of the satellite image the feature was mapped from.

table:columns.name: SensorID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `SensorID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Very High; 2 = Medium; 3 = Uncertain; 4 = To Be Evaluated. The decoded text is in `ConfidenceID_label`.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 0 = Not yet field validated; 1 = Validated (correct); 2 = Validated (not correct); 3 = Site Not Identified in Image. The decoded text is in `FieldValidation_label`.

table:columns.name: Notes
table:columns.description: Free-text notes by the analyst.

table:columns.name: Main_Damage_Site_Class
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Destroyed; 2 = Severe Damage; 3 = Moderate Damage; 4 = Possible Damage; 5 = Impact Crater (Damage to Road); 6 = No Visible Damage; 7 = Impact Crater (Damage to Field); 8 = Destroyed (Demolition Zone); 9 = Suspected Phosphorus shell Attack Zone; 10 = Road Damage from Tank Passage; 11 = Possible Damage from adjacent impact, debris; 12 = Lava Flow. The decoded text is in `Main_Damage_Site_Class_label`.

table:columns.name: Grouped_Damage_Classes
table:columns.description: Coded value. The source geodatabase domain gives: 1 = Damaged Buildings; 2 = Damaged Greenhouses; 3 = Impacts on Roads / Bridges; 4 = Impacts in Fields; 5 = Damaged Road segments. The decoded text is in `Grouped_Damage_Classes_label`.

table:columns.name: StaffID
table:columns.description: Coded value. The 2 source files of this collection use 2 different domains for it, so read `StaffID_label`, which is decoded per source file.

table:columns.name: EventCode
table:columns.description: UNOSAT event code (or a Copernicus EMSR id), as recorded on the feature. It does not always equal the code of the event subcatalog.

table:columns.name: Area_m2
table:columns.description: Area in square metres, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Area_ha
table:columns.description: Area in hectares, as UNOSAT computed it.

table:columns.name: Shape_Length
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: Shape_Area
table:columns.description: Computed by ArcGIS in the units of the source layer's CRS (degrees for EPSG:4326), so it is not a metric measure.

table:columns.name: ConfidenceID_label
table:columns.description: `ConfidenceID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: FieldValidation_label
table:columns.description: `FieldValidation` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Grouped_Damage_Classes_label
table:columns.description: `Grouped_Damage_Classes` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: Main_Damage_Site_Class_label
table:columns.description: `Main_Damage_Site_Class` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SensorID_label
table:columns.description: `SensorID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: SiteID_label
table:columns.description: `SiteID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: StaffID_label
table:columns.description: `StaffID` decoded with the coded-value domain of the source geodatabase. Null where the source had no domain or the code is not in it.

table:columns.name: geometry
table:columns.description: Feature geometry, as UNOSAT published it (not repaired).

table:columns.name: source_layer
table:columns.description: Name of the layer in the source file that this row came from.

table:columns.name: source_file
table:columns.description: Name of the file downloaded from HDX that this row came from.

table:columns.name: bbox
table:columns.type: struct<xmin: double, ymin: double, xmax: double, ymax: double>
table:columns.description: Bounding box of the geometry (xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax), added for spatial filtering.
